# The Evaluation Field Guide
> A concept-first guide to designing, interpreting and operating evaluations of AI systems, agents and real workflows.

## Guide
- [Wiki](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/index.html)
- [Full Markdown](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/llms-full.md)
- [Sources](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/sources.html)
- [Methodology](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/methodology.html)

## Concepts
- [What evaluation can establish: design, evidence and uncertainty](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/what-an-ai-evaluation-can-and-cannot-establish.html): Teaches evaluation structure, evidence scope, uncertainty in claims and evaluation maturity; specific experimental estimators and product economics belong elsewhere. Owns control, sampling, uncertainty and causal interpretation; does not teach item-response models.
- [From business problem to meaningful success criteria](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/from-business-problem-to-meaningful-success-criteria.html): Owns problem framing, construct selection and customer interpretation; detailed experiment design and model comparisons are separate.
- [Benchmarks, leaderboards and model selection](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/benchmarks-leaderboards-and-model-selection.html): Owns benchmark transfer, rank interpretation, lifecycle and local selection; does not replace measurement of deployed-system reliability.
- [Tracing, failure analysis and evaluator methods](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/tracing-failure-analysis-and-evaluator-methods.html): Owns trace evidence, diagnostic scope and evaluator methods; execution environment design and statistical comparison are separate.
- [Defining agent roles, boundaries and oversight](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-contracts-completion-and-oversight.html): Owns contracts, responsibilities and completion claims; business goal setting and runtime implementation are adjacent but separate. Owns architecture vocabulary and system-level attribution; retrieval internals and model selection are treated elsewhere.
- [Building and maintaining evaluation coverage](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/building-and-maintaining-evaluation-coverage.html): Owns evaluation settings, regression promotion, changing architecture and ownership; evaluator machinery is covered in the trace article.
- [Improvement loops, adaptation and overfitting](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/improvement-loops-adaptation-and-overfitting.html): Owns optimization loops and adaptation tradeoffs; empirical comparison design and memory architecture are separate.
- [Understanding context, memory and retrieval](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/context-memory-and-retrieval-foundations.html): Owns knowledge and context access, memory and retrieval mechanisms; screen observations and general model architecture are separate.
- [Choosing tasks with verifiable outcomes](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/choosing-verifiable-tasks-and-learning-methods.html): Owns task verifiability and training suitability, not claims of measured ROI or model superiority.
- [Evaluating visual and multimodal agent capabilities](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/visual-and-multimodal-agent-capabilities.html): Owns modality and platform distinctions; generic agent traces and retrieval are covered elsewhere.
- [Testing specialized representations and instruction robustness](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/specialized-representations-and-identity-tasks.html): Owns distinct representations for language and biological data and anonymous-speaker labeling; does not claim cross-domain equivalence. Owns the lexical instruction-density experiment, its failure categories and relevant robustness probes; general agent failure diagnosis belongs with traces.
- [Item response models for evaluation](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/item-response-models-for-evaluation.html): Owns IRT estimation and diagnostics, not general case-by-case experiment diffs or causal claims about model ancestry.
- [Choosing and designing agent benchmarks](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/choosing-and-designing-agent-benchmarks.html): Covers task selection and validity, not experimental execution.
- [Choosing agent success measures and resource budgets](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/measuring-success-horizon-and-resources.html): Defines distinct estimands and accounting; not experimental validity or task construction.
- [Comparing agents without confounding the result](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/comparing-agents-without-confounding-the-result.html): Covers treatment identity and execution integrity, not evaluation task meaning.
- [Verifying agent outcomes and diagnosing behavior](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/scoring-outcomes-and-diagnosing-behavior.html): Covers score surfaces and diagnostic traces, not verifier security or environment fidelity.
- [Building and validating simulated agent worlds](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/build-and-validate-simulated-agent-worlds.html): Design scenarios and stateful environments, and validate user behavior and environmental fidelity against relevant real observations.
- [Protect benchmark integrity](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/protect-benchmark-integrity.html): Covers leakage and scoring exploits; not general simulator validity.
- [Evaluating retrieval, memory and learning in agent workflows](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluate-retrieval-memory-and-learning-in-agent-loops.html): Covers informational capabilities; general experimental controls are taught separately.
- [Design evaluation distributions for decisions](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/design-evaluation-distributions-for-decisions.html): Coverage and estimands rather than individual-label accuracy.
- [Build and maintain production-grounded evaluation sets](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/build-and-maintain-production-grounded-evaluation-sets.html): Collection, refresh and incident regression rather than synthetic generation.
- [Protect holdouts and historical evidence](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/protect-holdouts-and-historical-evidence.html): Separates adaptive test reuse, training exposure, entity leakage and future information.
- [Specify and audit meaningful benchmark tasks](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/specify-and-audit-meaningful-benchmark-tasks.html): Task-level construct and verifier validity rather than population coverage.
- [Generate synthetic cases without mistaking them for reality](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/generate-synthetic-cases-without-mistaking-them-for-reality.html): Recipes, checks and sampling limitations; interactive simulators are treated separately.
- [Collect and interpret human judgments](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/collect-and-interpret-human-judgments.html): Human labeling and evidence quality rather than test-distribution design.
- [Evaluate and represent retrieval corpora](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluate-and-represent-retrieval-corpora.html): Retrieval and corpus preparation rather than final-answer grading.
- [Build data for training and agent improvement](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/build-data-for-training-and-agent-improvement.html): Training-data selection rather than independent evaluation outcomes.
- [Preserve meaning and interpret measurements](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/preserve-meaning-and-interpret-measurements.html): Measurement semantics and reproducibility rather than evaluator sampling.
- [Validate judges against human labels](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/validate-judges-against-human-labels.html): Alignment and classifier errors, not truth or probability calibration.
- [Agreement, truth and the limits of evaluator proxies](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agreement-truth-and-the-limits-of-evaluator-proxies.html): Epistemic and construct-validity limits, not the operational labeling procedure.
- [Give judges the evidence and context they need](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/give-judges-the-evidence-and-context-they-need.html): Evidence access and verification, not judge error-rate estimation.
- [Turn task quality into actionable evaluation rubrics](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/turn-task-quality-into-actionable-evaluation-rubrics.html): Criteria and score labels, not comparative estimands or evaluator architecture.
- [Compare systems, confidence and behavior without mixing estimands](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/compare-systems-confidence-and-behavior-without-mixing-estimands.html): Statistical comparison and confidence, not judge implementation or truth claims.
- [Choose and combine judge methods](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/choose-and-combine-judge-methods.html): Evaluator architectures and process grading, not their continuing operations.
- [Operate and improve evaluation systems](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/operate-and-improve-evaluation-systems.html): Maintenance, triage and feedback loops, not initial architecture design.
- [Verification contracts and evidence](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/verification-contracts-and-evidence.html): Owns intent, claims and evidence; execution mechanics belong in the feedback-loop and product-testing articles.
- [Building verification feedback and integration gates](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-feedback-loops-and-integration-gates.html): Owns orchestration, repository readiness and integration gates, not the detailed test oracle.
- [Testing product behavior and visual regressions](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/behavioral-and-visual-product-verification.html): Owns exercised workflows, visual behavior and durable effects; replay infrastructure belongs in the visual-regression article. Owns differential observation and replay controls, not general browser-based feature acceptance.
- [Tests, oracles and verifier validity](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/tests-oracles-and-verifier-validity.html): Owns task construction, test-oracle validity and benchmark security; ordinary product execution is covered separately.
- [Formal verification and executable constraints](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/formal-verification-and-executable-constraints.html): Owns deductive guarantees and executable structural constraints, not the organization’s process for choosing review policies.
- [Code review, human judgment and organizational risk](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/code-review-and-organizational-risk.html): Owns review decisions, human accountability and organizational measurement; technical integration diagnosis belongs elsewhere.
- [Diagnosing failures across system boundaries](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/diagnosis-and-cross-system-safety.html): Owns causal debugging and integration context; GPU-specific failure modes are treated in performance verification.
- [Verifying performance and kernel changes](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/performance-and-kernel-verification.html): Owns benchmark integrity, numerical fidelity and concurrency/state failures in optimized workloads, rather than general verifier auditing.
- [Define domain success and expert accountability](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/define-domain-success-and-expert-accountability.html): Covers define domain success and expert accountability; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Evaluating evidence-heavy financial work](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/financial-research-sources-and-forecasts.html): Covers financial research, sources and forecasts; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Grounding answers in retrieved evidence](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluate-retrieval-and-grounded-answers.html): Evaluate answer support against approved sources, then diagnose domain-agent tool-use failures and evidence-backed incident explanations.
- [Voice interaction and speech system evaluation](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/voice-interaction-and-speech-system-evaluation.html): Covers voice interaction and speech system evaluation; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Clinical safety and operational review](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/clinical-safety-and-operational-review.html): Covers clinical safety and operational review; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Document extraction and legal review](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/document-extraction-and-legal-review.html): Covers document extraction and legal review; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Synthetic respondents and historical personas](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/synthetic-respondents-and-historical-personas.html): Covers synthetic respondents and historical personas; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Visual media and physical systems](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/visual-media-and-physical-systems.html): Covers visual media and physical systems; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Creative quality and accessibility](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/creative-quality-and-accessibility.html): Covers creative quality and accessibility; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Preference discovery and recommendations](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/preference-discovery-and-recommendations.html): Covers preference discovery and recommendations; other articles own their distinct mechanisms and evaluation targets.
- [Matching evidence and autonomy to risk](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/risk-based-safety-and-staged-autonomy.html): Focus on system risk, harm prioritization and deployment decisions; detailed technical enforcement belongs in agent controls.
- [Prompt Injection and Agent Threat Modeling](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/prompt-injection-and-agent-threat-modeling.html): Explain attack paths and threat models; grant enforcement is treated in the access-control article.
- [Agent Authority, Isolation and Runtime Controls](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-authority-isolation-and-runtime-controls.html): Own permissions, execution and emergency control; privacy retention and tenancy have their own article.
- [Human Review and Agent Governance](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/human-review-and-agent-governance.html): Covers approval design and governance ownership, not clinical intervention policy.
- [Privacy, Tenancy and Data Governance](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/privacy-tenancy-and-data-governance.html): Own data use, tenant access and privacy; agent credential brokering is in runtime controls.
- [Agent and Dependency Supply-Chain Security](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-and-dependency-supply-chain-security.html): Own artifact distribution, dependencies and code vulnerabilities; injection mechanics are in threat modeling.
- [Payment and Purchase Security for Agents](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/payment-and-purchase-security-for-agents.html): Own purchase-specific controls rather than the general action broker.
- [Probing safety behavior and reward proxies](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/safety-evaluation-and-adversarial-probing.html): Own behavior testing and scoring; application security exploitation is covered separately.
- [Evaluating clinical guardrails and response calibration](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/clinical-guardrails-and-response-calibration.html): Own placement and clinical intervention calibration rather than universal security authorization.
- [Security Discovery, Exploit Verification and Remediation](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/security-discovery-exploit-verification-and-remediation.html): Own technical findings workflow; behavior-level red teaming and runtime authorization have separate articles.
- [Observability, Monitoring and Audit Integrity](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/observability-monitoring-and-audit-integrity.html): Own live detection and audit integrity; sensitive trace retention belongs in privacy.
- [Integrity of Safety and Benchmark Evidence](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/integrity-of-safety-and-benchmark-evidence.html): Own evaluation integrity and output evidence, not production tenant authorization.
- [Measuring useful outcomes and business value](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/measuring-business-value.html): Business estimands and baselines, not release-control mechanics. Mandates, outcome measures and adoption rather than the mechanics of implementing controls.
- [Monitoring production quality and improvement](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/production-evaluation-and-monitoring.html): Operational measurement and uncertainty, not human decision rights. Owns quality signals, test evolution, risk and task outcomes; execution traces and platform plumbing are covered elsewhere. Observability, discovery and continuous evaluation rather than offline release authorization.
- [Production governance, readiness and release](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/production-governance-and-release.html): Release and accountability decisions, not detailed security threat controls. Owns readiness, explicit promotion criteria, judge stability and recovery checks; live monitoring is elsewhere. Owns exposure, accountability and runtime safeguards; evaluation methods are separate.
- [Tracing and diagnosing production behavior](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-observability-and-diagnosis.html): Evidence capture and root-cause investigation, not a proof of user-visible success. Owns trace collection, privacy, triage, attribution and cost; it does not itself decide release readiness. Owns live discovery and incident handling; release gates and memory maintenance are separate.
- [Learning from production evidence and regression tests](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/learning-from-production.html): Improvement processes and feedback, not raw execution controls. Behavioral suites and predeployment evidence rather than continuous production monitoring. Owns task verification, comparisons and replay; incident management is separate.
- [Maintaining agent context, memory and knowledge](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/reliable-agent-context-and-memory.html): Knowledge and retrieval state, not transactional execution guarantees. Owns retention, retrieval and maintenance of working knowledge; external-source provenance is separate. Procedural knowledge and recurring jobs, not generic trace storage. Owns reusable knowledge lifecycle; working-session context belongs to execution.
- [Operating secure, governed agent environments](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/security-and-agent-operations.html): Security-specific threats and controls, distinct from general release decisions. Workload execution, access and infrastructure testing rather than semantic product quality.
- [Managing production retrieval, data and provenance](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/retrieval-evidence-and-provenance.html): Manage retrieval configuration, exact document and inventory access, and source provenance, including governed trace-data storage and document evidence pipelines. Trace instrumentation, interpretation and incident triage belong to the observability guide; retrieval optimization is covered separately.
- [Delivering agent-assisted work with human review](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/planning-and-delivering-agent-assisted-software.html): Owns software-delivery practices and adoption; runtime controls and evaluation infrastructure are separate. Review capacity, decisions and handoffs rather than test-suite construction.
- [Voice-agent operations](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/voice-agent-operations.html): Owns audio timing, conversational concurrency and voice telemetry; generic tracing belongs elsewhere.
- [Evaluation infrastructure and team ownership](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluation-platform-and-team-ownership.html): Owns human responsibilities and reusable experimentation infrastructure, not specific monitoring choices. Owns team responsibilities and architectural capacity, not individual launch approvals.
- [Validating model and serving systems](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/inference-and-serving-operations.html): Owns model-serving compatibility, availability and research control rather than task-level agent quality. Model, backend and serving lifecycle rather than user-facing product adoption.
- [Managing agent task flow and action evidence](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-task-flow-and-action-evidence.html): Own task progression, action evidence and handoffs; not general-purpose evaluation metrics or permission policy.
- [Running and resuming agent sessions](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-sessions-and-long-running-work.html): Own session lifecycle, persistence and event execution; distinguish working-session state from curated organizational memory.
- [Choosing agent delegation and coordination](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-delegation-and-coordination.html): Own topology, specialist coordination and capacity tradeoffs; link model portfolio selection to routing-and-deployment.
- [Designing agent-facing product interactions](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/agent-product-interaction-surfaces.html): Own interaction surfaces and application-facing workflows; not the tool catalog or authorization contract.
- [Comparing task quality, cost and value](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/decision-economics.html): Covers outcome economics and controlled comparisons, not inference-server tuning. Accounting and value proxies, not inference-server configuration.
- [Allocating models and deployment resources](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/routing-and-deployment.html): Covers task routing, provider selection and specialization rather than low-level serving internals. Application model quality and choices, rather than hardware-level serving metrics.
- [Designing efficient agent workflows](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/workflow-design.html): Covers delivery loops and replay, not retrieval context or production serving. Trajectory and development workflow design, not evaluator scheduling.
- [Managing context, retrieval and cache costs](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/context-and-retrieval.html): Covers retrieval and context policies, not tool catalog interfaces or inference cache billing. Covers prefix placement, replica locality and billing rather than general KV sizing. Context, knowledge and retrieval economics, not model-selection economics.
- [Tool interfaces](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/tool-interfaces.html): Tool affordances and invocation, schema discovery and progressive loading of instructions.
- [Measuring inference serving performance](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/inference-serving.html): Covers inference phases, metrics, concurrency and KV capacity, not user-facing voice or specific decoding techniques. Service performance and resource provisioning, not business ROI or kernel algebra.
- [Speculative decoding](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/speculative-decoding.html): Covers token-level speculation, not speculative voice pipeline execution.
- [Verifying hardware and training optimizations](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/gpu-optimization.html): Covers kernels, precision and training-memory tradeoffs, not service-level SLO sweeps. Kernel mechanics and training architectures, not general model routing.
- [Interactive latency](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/interactive-latency.html): Covers voice stage readiness and overlap, not aggregate inference throughput.
- [Budgeting evaluation and monitoring](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluation-infrastructure.html): Covers evaluation feedback and monitor budgets rather than product-task quality itself. Evaluation, verification and monitoring economics, not serving configuration.
- [Evaluation-driven improvement](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/evaluation-driven-improvement.html): Covers experiment design and regression evidence, not the optimizer’s search algorithm.
- [Search and objective integrity](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/search-and-objective-integrity.html): Covers objectives, governance and acceptance decisions, not domain-specific candidate-generation methods.
- [Prompt and harness optimization](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/prompt-and-harness-optimization.html): Covers prompt, orchestration and memory updates, not weight-training algorithms.
- [Retrieval and query optimization](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/retrieval-and-query-optimization.html): Covers retrieval and tool-access mechanisms, not general context compaction or downstream model training.
- [Model selection and runtime efficiency](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/model-selection-and-runtime-efficiency.html): Covers runtime selection and acceleration, not training model specialization.
- [Training and distillation](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/training-and-distillation.html): Covers weight-update data, objectives and validation; prompt-only and runtime interventions belong elsewhere.
- [Using production feedback to improve systems](https://flaviusapop.github.io/ai-engineer-evals/wiki/articles/production-feedback-and-improvement.html): Covers production feedback workflows and development leverage, not the generic acceptance loop.
